worldcombat.skill.appleacid.summary: Hurl a sour apple at a single target: a hit deals special damage, lowers its Sp. Def by 1 and leaves a ferment on it. A second apple that lands while the ferment is still on the same target hits harder (-2) and consumes the ferment, so the next one starts at -1 again. It never splashes or leaves a pool — only the target it actually strikes. A miss just spatters at the landing point, with no apple dropped. Ferment form is slower and lighter but keeps the window ×1.6 longer, making the second hit easier; burst form hits harder, flies faster and reaches further, but the acid does not linger.
worldcombat.skill.appleacid.use.0: Throw two apples at one target: the first lowers Sp. Def by 1 and leaves a ferment; a second within the window lowers it by 2 and consumes the ferment
worldcombat.skill.appleacid.use.1: Switch to ferment form to stretch the window and make the second hit easier
worldcombat.skill.appleacid.use.2: Free throw: land an apple on any entity or point
The target struck by the apple takes about %1$s special damage and has its Sp. Def lowered by %2$s stage(s).
The apple flies up to %1$s blocks at %2$s blocks per tick; a free throw follows the submitted heading and only spatters where it lands.

Foes it hits carry this move's ferment for %2$s; a further apple on the same target before that acid fades lowers %1$s stage(s) of Sp. Def instead and consumes the ferment, so the next apple starts at -1 again.
worldcombat.skill.appleacid.ferment.on: Ferment form: impact about %1$s special damage; ferment %2$s — a slower, shorter-ranged apple, but far easier to land a second hit on one target.
worldcombat.skill.appleacid.ferment.off: Burst form: impact about %1$s special damage, ferment %2$s — a harder, faster, longer throw, but the acid does not linger.
worldcombat.skill.appleacid.timing: Range %1$s blocks, wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.appleacid.growth.0: From level %1$s the impact rises to %2$s power.
worldcombat.skill.appleacid.preference.f: On: a slower, lighter, shorter-ranged apple, but ferment ×1.6 — far easier to land a second hit on one target. Off (burst form): a harder, faster, longer throw, but a shorter window.
worldcombat.skill.appleacid.preference.a: Beyond this distance it closes in first. Larger values let it open from further away.

On: it prefers another apple at a target still carrying its own ferment, whose Sp. Def has not bottomed out and whose remaining window still lets the second apple land (the second hit is harsher, -2); it demotes fast movers and targets whose Sp. Def is already bottomed. Off: it sorts like an ordinary ranged attack.
